comment: GitHub #68, Kiln clients: the station screen's fill buttons. The game's UI action query UiActionStatus(gameUi, u32 station, u32 recipe, u32 item, u16 amount, u32 type, const RecipeInputCategorySelections*) -> u32 is a cached status (0 not run yet, 1 ok, else the dry run's code: 2 no room, 4 missing materials, 5 no inventory); the client program player_ui runs the dry runs (type 3: AutoTransferRecipe on the bag and the Magic chests). A production station's screen enables its '+1' and '+10' fill when the type-3 query answers 1. kiln-items raises a 4 to 1 only when the server said its fill with opted-in station outputs covers that many crafts. Not authority: the press is the game's own action, which the server's Kiln.Blocks runs as Kiln's fill. Found on client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1...) only. docs/re/stations.md section 10.3.

stations/client.UiActionStatus.comment: the key: +0 type ([rbp+0x38]), +4 station (edx), +0x1c recipe (r8d), +0x20 item (r9d), +0x24 u16 amount ([rbp+0x30]), +0x2c the 32-byte selections ([rbp+0x40]); the cache at gameUi+0x14f70 (its offset is not used). Client 26430625 0xb2dbe0

@stations/client.UiActionStatus.fill.comment: the station screen's '+1' fill: type 3 at [rsp+0x28], amount 1 at [rsp+0x20], then the call; its result compared with 1 is the button's enabled byte (client 26430625 0xc7451a; the '+10' at 0xc746f3 is the same with amount 10)
